propositions: Extract cohesive identity transition rules (bind, confirm, unbind, reverse cleanup, numeric-ID rekey) from BindingStore into BindingLifecycle policy owner while preserving exact existing behaviors and both-index invariants.
Every valid bind/confirm/unbind transition must leave at most one forward and one matching reverse identity, verified by reloading both indexes from disk after each transition.
bind_confirm performs last-writer-wins with exactly one targeted pop of the differing old reverse key, with no sweep, ambiguity detection, or abort.
Stale reverse entries are removed only in four permitted cases: bind_confirm rebind, unbind sweep, rekey old-key pop, and retire.

Numeric-ID rekey in BindingLifecycle.rekey re-keys by swapping both indexes, resetting absence_404_count, and updating updated_at; note_absent_or_rekey on facade remains coordinator with unchanged return contract and no outcome change.
Legacy records without numeric IDs retain current behavior; facade signatures and caller-visible outcomes are preserved exactly.
